notes: STEP 1 (load) + STEP 2 (explore) of the workshop's LendingClubLoan.sas, unmodified in logic: builds LCLoanData from LENDINGCLUBLOANDATA.csv, runs PROC CONTENTS/MEANS/PRINT, defines custom formats (posneg/agegroup/fico/...), PROC FREQ, PROC SORT, PROC UNIVARIATE by Default. The original INFILE read exported/data/LENDINGCLUBLOANDATA.csv from disk; since the runner ships only script text, a 25-row sample of that same file (same 17-column layout) is inlined via DATALINES/DSD instead. STEP 3-6 (Viya-only proc partition/forest/gradboost/astore, CAS-only) are out of scope for this bundle -- everything shipped here is standard SAS as the author wrote it.
